{{Quote|Maddeus provided me with a hyperdrive-equipped space yacht, Quarren Eye, just about the only resource he could give me.|Garik Loran|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''''Quarren Eye''''' was a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]-equipped space [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] given to [[Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] officer [[Garik Loran]] by the [[Director/Legends|Director]] of [[Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service]] [[Borath Maddeus]] as part of his investigation on [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], head of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]]. The ship's communication system was wired to transmit data back to Maddeus, which led to his implication when he tried to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Loran and a fictitious team of [[Wraith Squadron]] members that Loran had been ostensibly transmitting to using the ship's communication system.<ref name="MK" />
